objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Get past the DVTA client's controls and read the flag: it is an expense recorded for the admin user in DVTA's database.
hints: The client is a .NET program: a .NET decompiler shows how it enables its Configure button and how it reaches the database.
The admin's screen exports every expense; the client also carries what it needs to talk to the database itself.

steps.title: Identify the client
steps.prompt: On which framework is the DVTA client built? (name)

steps.title: Find the stored secret
steps.prompt: Which application setting in the client's config file holds the encrypted database password? (setting name)

steps.title: Name the cipher
steps.prompt: Which symmetric cipher protects that password? (name)

steps.title: Name the login flaw
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class does the login form's database query have?
